info.name: L4 SNI Router (proxy NLB, TLS-passthrough)
info.description:
Tests the standalone L4 SNI router (regional proxy Network LB + TLS routes, TLS-passthrough) at the PUBLIC VIP {{vip}}. Routing is purely by TLS SNI to 3 backends: httpbin.org / httpbingo.org / mocktarget.apigee.net. This is L4 (no HTTP/auth layer) — the origin's own TLS cert is validated end-to-end.

IMPORTANT — Postman/browsers can't do curl's --resolve, and a pure SNI router routes on the ClientHello SNI, so you MUST point the 3 hostnames at the VIP first. On the machine running Postman add to /etc/hosts (sudo):

    {{vip}}  httpbin.org httpbingo.org mocktarget.apigee.net

Then requests below hit the VIP with SNI=Host=<that hostname> and get routed. REMOVE those /etc/hosts lines when done (else all traffic to those hosts goes through the LB). In Postman Settings, keep SSL verification ON — the origin's real cert is served end-to-end, so it validates against the hostname.

curl alternative (no /etc/hosts, preferred):
  curl --resolve httpbin.org:443:{{vip}} https://httpbin.org/anything
  curl --resolve httpbingo.org:443:{{vip}} https://httpbingo.org/get
  curl --resolve mocktarget.apigee.net:443:{{vip}} https://mocktarget.apigee.net/json

request.description: SNI=httpbin.org -> TLS route -> backend A. httpbin.org resolves to the VIP via /etc/hosts.
